title: Foreman
sub: Describe a job in plain English and Foreman designs a worker for it. Open source, bring your own keys.

bullets.text: Lowered cost per run 30% vs an all-LLM pipeline on a 100-record paired benchmark: routed 5 of 7 steps to deterministic code, taking LLM calls per run from 11 to 6.

Drove repeated side effects after mid-run crashes to zero across 10 failure modes: a Postgres-backed run queue with leases, heartbeats, crash recovery and idempotent resume restores a crashed run within 3 minutes.
Every tool call behind server-side permission checks and every external action behind human approval: an AES-256-GCM credential vault with key rotation, SSRF and DNS-rebinding guards, spend caps.
